principle.name: LOAD RELEASE CHANGES ROOT ACCELERATION BEFORE SUPPORT CADENCE CAN REPHASE
principle.summary: A body already driving into external resistance does not instantly acquire a clean run cycle when resistance disappears. The planted support keeps driving, root spacing spikes, the first free probe lands long, and only successive catches can compress the surge back into a usable cadence.
principle.novelty: first locomotion specimen centered on an abrupt external-resistance change while the support domain remains feet; it studies acceleration/cadence debt rather than braking, curvature reversal, airborne handoff, support-height change, or rolling body support.

keys.name: LEFT_LOAD_BRACE
keys.causal_role: left support braces a resisted push; arms transmit load while COM stays behind the hands
keys.motion_arc_root_note: slow loaded travel / resistance owns acceleration

keys.name: LEFT_DRIVE_RIGHT_PROBE
keys.causal_role: left support drives the load while right foot probes ahead without stealing ownership

keys.name: RIGHT_CATCH_LOAD_COMPRESSION
keys.causal_role: right foot accepts load as body compresses forward; hands remain committed to resistance
keys.motion_arc_root_note: loaded catch / COM lowers under resistance

keys.name: RIGHT_DRIVE_LOAD_LIGHTENS
keys.causal_role: right support keeps driving as the external load begins to escape; left foot reaches but does not own
keys.motion_arc_root_note: resistance falling / cadence has not yet rephased

keys.name: LOAD_RELEASE_SPIKE
keys.causal_role: load outruns the hands; right support is still planted while torso surges into suddenly unresisted drive
keys.motion_arc_root_note: release impulse / root spacing expands before foot ownership can change

keys.name: FIRST_FREE_LEFT_PROBE
keys.causal_role: right support is stretched to its limit while left foot probes far ahead under a torso already escaping
keys.motion_arc_root_note: first free stride / maximal spacing after resistance loss

keys.name: LEFT_CATCH_SURGE_COMPRESSION
keys.causal_role: left catch finally owns the surge; pelvis drops while head, chest and arms overrun the planted foot
keys.motion_arc_root_note: catch spends released-load velocity / heavy compression

keys.name: LEFT_DRIVE_RIGHT_RECOVERY_PROBE
keys.causal_role: left support drives a shorter second stride while arms lag behind the body; right foot probes for cadence recovery

keys.name: RIGHT_CATCH_OVERSTRIDE
keys.causal_role: right catch arrests the overstride; support rebinds before posture can fully restack

keys.name: RIGHT_SUPPORT_LEFT_COUNTERPROBE
keys.causal_role: right support owns a short corrective step while left foot probes back under the COM instead of matching prior stride length

keys.name: LEFT_CATCH_BRAKE_SETTLE
keys.causal_role: left catch brakes the remaining surge; torso rises but the arms still carry release lag
keys.motion_arc_root_note: deceleration / settle begins at a displaced address

keys.name: LEFT_DRIVE_RIGHT_PROBE_RECOVERY_DEBT
keys.causal_role: left support makes one modest drive while right foot probes; recovery retains a forward task-ready bias
keys.motion_arc_root_note: small recovery travel / no idle reset

keys.name: RIGHT_CATCH_DISPLACED_READY
keys.causal_role: right catch stabilizes the new address with unequal feet and residual forward bias rather than returning to the initial brace
keys.motion_arc_root_note: displaced recovery debt / ready to continue

history.defect: During the resisted-drive keys, the generic load visibly floated several columns ahead of both hands, so the declared resistance contact was metadata rather than embodied causality.
history.correction: Mutate the same Locomotion016 keys K00-K03: move the authored generic load edge into direct hand contact while preserving foot support ownership, nonuniform loaded spacing, and the later release gap.

history.basis: Fresh inspection of the actual 36-frame final render: K00-K03 now show continuous hand-to-load contact under alternating foot ownership; K04 visibly breaks that contact before the root-spacing spike; K05 extends the first free probe; K06 compresses the long surge into the left catch; later catches progressively shorten spacing while torso/arm lag decays; the finish remains displaced and asymmetrical. No floating task contact, foot teleport into ownership, equal spacing, reverse interpolation, idle reset, or generic run-cycle substitution remains.

history.defect: The K07 world render still showed a clipped sliver of the generic load at the frame edge after TASK=LOAD_OFFSTAGE, weakening the release read and making the prop-state contract lie visually.
history.correction: Mutate the same body: remove the load from both world and local ASCII whenever TASK=LOAD_OFFSTAGE, leaving only body/support consequences after the release.

history.basis: Fresh actual-frame inspection after the same-body offstage-load correction: K00-K03 preserve continuous hand-to-load contact under alternating foot ownership; K04 breaks contact before root acceleration; K05 reaches the first free probe long; K06 catches/compresses the surge; K07 and every later key contain no visible load while support/root consequences continue; successive catches shorten spacing and bleed torso/arm lag into a displaced asymmetrical ready state. No floating load, decorative release label, foot teleport, equal spacing, straight root tweening, phase reset, reverse interpolation, or idle reset remains.

noodle_queen.basis: After current-worker Tango PASS on the same exact render: the jammed forward brace, abrupt empty-space lunge, long first free probe, ugly catch compression, progressively shortened corrective steps, persistent arm/torso lag, and displaced ready state form a specific load-release locomotion sentence. The vanished resistance stays vanished; the body alone carries the recovery debt. Economy reads as authored causality rather than a push/run icon swap.
